summary.en-US: Per-page request firewall with geoip, geosite, domain regex, and IP range rules

description.en-US: GeoLock is a Firefox extension that blocks or allows sub-resource requests with per-page rules using v2fly geoip/geosite, domain regex, and IP range matchers.

version.approval_notes: Build: npm ci && npm run build. Plain ES modules, no bundler or minification. Tests: node tests/run.mjs. Geo data is fetched at runtime from user-configured URLs (not bundled).
